entities.name: Winarni Binti Slamet
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Winarni Binti Slamet is an Indonesian weightlifter who competed in the women's 53 kg at the 2000 Summer Olympics and won the bronze medal, lifting 202.5 kg in total. Also she won the World Championship in 1997.
